_comment: Sinai-67, Israel, turns 1–3 by the history (Oren, «Six Days of War»; Dupuy, «Elusive Victory»): 84th division (Tal) at the Rafah junction, then El Arish through Jiradi; 38th (Sharon) at Umm Katef / Abu Ageila, the main attack on the night of turn 2 with artillery, the 80th paratroop brigade on the batteries, tanks and infantry; 31st (Yoffe) between them through the dunes to Bir Lahfan, then towards Jebel Libni. Bir Lahfan (20,6) and Jebel Libni (18,9) are hexes read off the road data (±1 hex). Other formations, aircraft and economy — the side's AI. Rebalancing, step 2a: sim ai-vs-ai --script.

phases._comment: night 5–6 June: Sharon's night attack on Umm Katef; Tal past Jiradi to El Arish
